from __future__ import annotations

import calendar
import math
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Duration:
    years: int = 0
    months: int = 0
    weeks: int = 0
    days: int = 0
    hours: int = 0
    minutes: int = 0
    seconds: float = 0


# Order is enforced by the pattern itself: each part appears at most once and
# only in the documented position.  ``T`` is optional, but when present at
# least one time part must follow it (checked separately in ``parse``).
_DURATION_RE = re.compile(
    r"P"
    r"(?:(?P<years>[0-9]+)Y)?"
    r"(?:(?P<months>[0-9]+)M)?"
    r"(?:(?P<weeks>[0-9]+)W)?"
    r"(?:(?P<days>[0-9]+)D)?"
    r"(?:T"
    r"(?:(?P<hours>[0-9]+)H)?"
    r"(?:(?P<minutes>[0-9]+)M)?"
    r"(?:(?P<seconds>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)S)?"
    r")?"
)

_TIME_PARTS = ("hours", "minutes", "seconds")
_DATE_PARTS = ("years", "months", "weeks", "days")


def parse(text: str) -> Duration:
    """Parse an ISO 8601 duration."""
    match = _DURATION_RE.fullmatch(text)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid ISO 8601 duration: {text!r}")

    values = match.groupdict()
    if all(value is None for value in values.values()):
        # Reject ``P`` and ``PT``: at least one part is required.
        raise ValueError(f"invalid ISO 8601 duration: {text!r}")
    if "T" in text and all(values[part] is None for part in _TIME_PARTS):
        # Reject a bare ``T`` with no time part after it.
        raise ValueError(f"invalid ISO 8601 duration: {text!r}")

    seconds = 0.0
    if values["seconds"] is not None:
        seconds = float(values["seconds"])
        if not math.isfinite(seconds):
            raise ValueError(f"invalid ISO 8601 duration: {text!r}")

    return Duration(
        years=int(values["years"] or 0),
        months=int(values["months"] or 0),
        weeks=int(values["weeks"] or 0),
        days=int(values["days"] or 0),
        hours=int(values["hours"] or 0),
        minutes=int(values["minutes"] or 0),
        seconds=seconds,
    )


def _check_non_negative(duration: Duration) -> None:
    for name in _DATE_PARTS + _TIME_PARTS:
        value = getattr(duration, name)
        if value < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"duration component {name} must be non-negative")
    if not math.isfinite(duration.seconds):
        raise ValueError("duration component seconds must be finite")


def _format_seconds(seconds: float) -> str:
    value = Decimal(str(seconds))
    if value == value.to_integral_value():
        return str(int(value))
    text = format(value, "f")
    if "." in text:
        text = text.rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    return text


def format(duration: Duration) -> str:
    """Write ``duration`` in canonical ISO 8601 form."""
    _check_non_negative(duration)

    date_parts = []
    for value, suffix in (
        (duration.years, "Y"),
        (duration.months, "M"),
        (duration.weeks, "W"),
        (duration.days, "D"),
    ):
        if value:
            date_parts.append(f"{value}{suffix}")

    time_parts = []
    for value, suffix in ((duration.hours, "H"), (duration.minutes, "M")):
        if value:
            time_parts.append(f"{value}{suffix}")
    if duration.seconds:
        time_parts.append(f"{_format_seconds(duration.seconds)}S")

    if not date_parts and not time_parts:
        return "PT0S"
    text = "P" + "".join(date_parts)
    if time_parts:
        text += "T" + "".join(time_parts)
    return text


def add(moment: datetime, duration: Duration) -> datetime:
    """``moment`` plus ``duration``."""
    _check_non_negative(duration)
